verdict_reason: Re-derived Roy & Vetterli 2007 Eq. (1)/Def. 1 (p_k = sigma_k/||sigma||_1, erank = exp H(p), RAW singular values) and checked the current per-layer kernel against an independent float64 centred SVD: worst relative error 5.250e-15 over all 13 gpt2 layers. Roy-Vetterli Property 2 (erank(cA) = erank(A)) holds to <=7.0e-08 over the whole scale ladder 1e-30..6.656e17, and the previously-reported 2.406e38 failure is closed -- 15.748967374068759 against a float64 truth of 15.748967374068751. On-grid translation by +1e6 moves erank by 2.136e-11, and BLME reproduces the float64 truth digit-for-digit at every offset.
comparable_reason: erank is a dimension count, so the raw profile is dominated by width and by token population. iid Gaussian at N=1200: erank 7.993 / 31.879 / 126.262 / 480.495 at d = 8 / 32 / 128 / 512 (60.1x). At d=128: erank 30.004 / 102.310 / 123.630 / 126.228 at N = 32 / 128 / 512 / 1200 (4.21x), so a model evaluated on fewer surviving tokens reads lower for a reason that is not representational. collapse_ratio, a min/max within one model, is the only dimensionless headline.
github_reason: Roy & Vetterli 2007 (EUSIPCO) released no code; Jing et al. 2110.09348's repo computes a singular-value spectrum but not this erank. I therefore verified against an independently written float64 reference (centre, np.linalg.svd, L1-normalise, exp of Shannon entropy) rather than a released one: worst relative error 5.250e-15 on 13 real gpt2 layers, and identical values under translation and rescaling.
paper_reason: Roy & Vetterli publish properties rather than a table of values for a named model, and all of them are reproduced exactly: a flat spectrum of n equal singular values must give erank = n -- measured 5.000000000000001 for n=5 and 19.999999999999996 for n=20; a rank-one matrix must give exactly 1.0 -- measured 1.0; Property 1 (erank >= 1 for any nonzero matrix) holds on all 6 degenerate_spectra fixtures, including 'two positives + 62 exact zeros' at 1.649384888466 and 'one dominant + tiny tail' at exactly 1.0. No published erank scalar exists for gpt2 on a stated corpus.
confounds_reason: Raw erank IS essentially d_model on iid data -- erank/d = 0.999 / 0.996 / 0.986 / 0.938 at d = 8 / 32 / 128 / 512 -- so max_erank, min_erank and max_drop are width proxies by construction, and additionally a token-count proxy (4.21x over N=32..1200 at fixed d). collapse_ratio is the only headline that is not.
defects: NORMALIZED VARIANT IS BACKWARDS: the /d_model twins CREATE a width dependence where the raw quantity has none. Zero-padding a fixed 1200x8 cloud to d = 8 / 32 / 128 / 512 leaves raw erank bit-identical at 7.993169268503 for all four, while _meta_max_erank_frac reads 0.999146158563 / 0.249786539641 / 0.062446634910 / 0.015611658728 -- exactly 64x apart for the SAME geometry. These twins should not be used as normalized predictors.
COMPARABILITY (not implementation): raw erank 7.993 -> 480.495 over d=8..512 and 30.004 -> 126.228 over N=32..1200 on iid Gaussians.
